challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and I need to act before the next promotion week. I am prepared to accept a reduction in the automation level of the logging pipeline if it cuts the cost significantly. I would rather have a manual review process for the drift checks than pay for a fully automated system that drains our budget. I am not willing to fund automated drift monitoring at this price point. If we can lower the automation on the logging side to save money, I will sign off on that trade. I am not asking for a perfect solution, just a way to keep the lights on without breaking the finance team.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states a willingness to accept a reduction in automation levels in exchange for significant cost savings, identifying a specific concession they are prepared to make.
